blocks.text: Monoclonal antibodies personalized medicine (har mareez ke mutabiq ilaaj) ka ahem hissa hain; in se har mareez ki apni maloomat (patient profile) ki bunyad par ilaaj banaya ja sakta hai. In antibodies ke design aur tayyari mein musalsal nayi ijaad (innovation) zaroori hai taa ke ilaaj zyada mo'assar ho aur har mareez ki apni biology ke mutabiq behtar ho.
Monoclonal antibodies ke ahem fawaid yeh hain:

items: Riwayati (traditional) dawaon ke muqable mein in ka zehreela pan (toxicity) kam hai aur in ka asar der tak reh sakta hai.
Aam chemotherapy (cancer ki kimiyai dawaon) ke muqable mein in ke side effects sab se kam hain.
In ki specificity (khaas pan) bohat zyada hai: har aik sirf aik target se jurti hai, aur in mein farq bohat kam hota hai.
Cancer mein yeh targeted therapy (sirf nishane par ilaaj) deti hain, is liye sehatmand tissues ko kam nuqsan hota hai.
Kitab ke mutabiq yeh aasani se tayyar hoti hain aur research ke kaam aati hain.
Yeh doosri dawaon ke saath rad-e-amal (drug interactions) ka khatra kam karti hain.

blocks.text: Kitab mazeed kehti hai ke yeh technologies hazaron mumkina antibodies ko aik saath test karne deti hain; is se nayi dawa tayyar hone ka waqt kam hota hai aur infectious bimariyon aur cancer jaise fauri masail ka jaldi jawab diya ja sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Cancer ke ilaaj mein monoclonal antibodies sehatmand tissue ko kam nuqsan kyun deti hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh sirf apne khaas target antigen se jurti hain jo cancer cells par hota hai; aam chemotherapy har taizi se taqseem hone wale cell ko nuqsan deti hai, chahe woh sehatmand ho.

items: Fawaid: kam toxicity, kam side effects, zyada specificity, targeted cancer therapy, research mein istemal, kam drug interactions.
